data.title: Which is Longer?
data.description: Measure two fun objects with cubes and compare their lengths!

challenges.instruction: Measure the crayon and the straw with cubes. Which one is longer?
challenges.hint: Lay the cubes end to end along each one and count them. Then look at your two counts.
challenges.narration: Measure the crayon and the straw with cubes. Which one is longer?

challenges.instruction: Measure the pencil and the paintbrush with cubes. Which one is longer?
challenges.hint: Lay the cubes end to end along each one and count them. Then look at your two counts.
challenges.narration: Measure the pencil and the paintbrush with cubes. Which one is longer?

challenges.instruction: Measure the straw and the pencil with cubes. Which one is shorter?
challenges.hint: Lay the cubes end to end along each one and count them. Then look at your two counts.
